There is never an InTr hop inside one org."); LLM-adapter only as an endpoint after an external machine has established itself as a healthy node, or not at all (#162 c6391743862: "LLM-adapter's only InTr use is when an external machine has established itself as a healthy node; that node may then become an InTr endpoint"); no external machine (StegVerse-org/.github docs/ORGANIZATION_ROLE_RUNTIME_REALITY_DEPLOYMENT.md:53, "There are no and will be no external machines awaiting anything", and :60, "No surface requires an external machine, a second user-operated device, or a remote computer, and none may be introduced as a completion predicate, machine dependency or substrate-unsuitability finding" - so the EPHEMERAL external node is barred); no ledger dispatch; KV's own head record stays the authority (ruling A, StegVerse-org/.github#167 c6392982821: "KV's own head record is the authority, and the caller watermark is an optional claim"); rollback and replay detection on KV's own head stays valid on the LC-KV-26 basis (#167 c6393119202: "a crossing record held at both ends (the org side and KV's own ledger), never an InTr hop inside one org"). The withdrawn edge built an intra-org InTr crossing through LLM-adapter and relied on an EPHEMERAL external node; both are gone from this item, its plan runs and its scoped tasks, and it has no unadmitted dependency. At continuity-vault-kit main @acfd2be5 (continuity-vault-kit#275 closed LC-KV-26; run cvk263-chain-probe) every required row decides as declared: KV's own head record decides rollback (an older genuinely signed head is DENY KV_LEDGER_HEAD_ROLLBACK_DETECTED whatever the caller claims; the caller watermark is an optional claim, ruling A), and a read-back head is ALLOW only when it is held at both ends (KV end only, or an Org record naming only an older head, is six-field FAIL_CLOSED KV_CROSSING_RECORD_NOT_OBSERVED; a rollback after the last crossing is DENY), for kv and for skap_vault through SkapLayer2Gate. Production prerequisites (run cvk263-anchor-production-prerequisites) are each six-field FAIL_CLOSED and are the three remaining allow_path blockers plus ORG-LEDGER-HEAD-SIGNER-001. Note for Lane D (class A cleanup, not a bypass): cvk's reader uses vendored chain and Ed25519 helpers under runtime/intr_pinned; that is library code inside KV, not LLM-adapter acting as an endpoint and not an InTr hop. SKAP Vault inside KV is the only PII and credential store for every user, the ecosystem's own included; the ecosystem holds none (HST citation pending P1 #163).
items.subject: ENDPOINT_LEDGER_ANCHOR_SUITE
items.what: the cvk-only both-ends anchor of KV's own receipt chains (revision 16, Coordination ruling): KV's own hash-linked, monotonic head record (head-record.v1.jsonl) is the authority for KV's read-back head (ruling A), and a read-back head is ALLOW only when it is also named by the Org side's digest-only crossing record, so it is held at both ends (LC-KV-26, continuity-vault-kit#275); decided by continuity-vault-kit runtime/kv_receipt_ledgers.py read_receipt_ledger, for kv and for skap_vault only through SkapLayer2Gate. No LLM-adapter endpoint, no InTr hop inside an org, no external machine, no ledger dispatch.
